title: Order Status State Machine
description: Defines the statuses an order or sub-order of this order_type can be in, and the allowed transitions between them. Every order/sub-order has its own, independent position in this state machine - a sub-order reaching a terminal status does not by itself change its parent's status (see completion-rule.schema.json).

terminal.description: True if no further transitions are expected from this status (e.g. 'shipped', 'cancelled'). completion_rule.when.status typically references a terminal status.

trigger.description: Optional description of what causes this transition.
